Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the impact of statewide initiatives on local tax authority.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to statewide initiatives that impact local taxauthority; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.72 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any provision within an initiative approved by the voters thatamends, repeals, or otherwise modifies a local tax imposed by anycounty, city, town, or other municipal corporation shall take effectonly if a majority of the voters voting on the initiative who livewithin the boundaries of the county, city, town, or municipalcorporation approve the initiative. (2) Subsection (1) of this section does not invalidate otherprovisions of an initiative if the remaining provisions are severable.Provisions are severable if they are independent in purpose and expresswritten construction.
